# MTE Solutions Inc.

> > MTE Solutions Inc. is a specialized distributor of precision tools and equipment for electronics manufacturing, semiconductor work, and technical applications.

The company offers professional-grade products from leading manufacturers including Aven Tools, Botron, Eclipse Tools, MG Chemicals, Tronex, Hakko, and Gordon Brush. Their catalog focuses on precision hand tools, ESD-safe equipment, microscopy solutions, and soldering accessories designed for electronics assembly, PCB work, and semiconductor manufacturing.

## Key Topics

- Precision electronics tools
- ESD-safe equipment
- Titanium tweezers
- Non-magnetic tools
- Stainless steel tools
- Silicon chip industry
- Aven Tools products
- Botron tools
- Eclipse Tools
- MG Chemicals
- Hemostats and forceps
- Microscopy and magnification
- Soldering accessories
- Wire strippers and cutters
- Anti-static tools
